physical.mounting-hardware: Hex bolt x3, nut x3, washer x6 and split washer x3 (instruction sheet); midspan bracket x3

configs.description: The manager as APC ships AR8645, both doors fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with both doors taken off, the finger columns and the channels open to lay a cable in. The doors come with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: doors-off

gaps.note: each door "opens to left or right" on hinge pins and lifts off; no view dimensions a hinge. Each door is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the door's hinge pins and latch

gaps.note: the data sheet advertises "multiple internal cable tie-off locations"; the instruction sheet draws the plate's slots but dimensions none, and the format has no place to state a tie point on a duct (#1009 states them only on the FS tray). They are not drawn or stated.
gaps.wanted: the plate's slots dimensioned, and a place in the format for a duct's tie points

gaps.note: the instruction sheet shows an optional grounding and bonding point, a tab with a hole, "Hardware and cable not provided". No thread or hole size is stated, and a grounding point in the format is a stud or screw with a thread, so none is stated.
gaps.wanted: the size of the hole and the screw it takes

gaps.note: APC states "high capacity" and no figure on the data sheet, the instruction sheet or the brochure, so none is recorded and none is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity figure and the cable it is stated for

gaps.note: the instruction sheet's figure draws each finger as a smooth tongue with a rolled root; it is built as an arm 12 across and a hooked tip 22 across, 31 high, 296 long, and the 44 are counted, none of it dimensioned.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the back plate

gaps.note: where the first finger stands against the rack's units is not stated; the fingers are centred on the 2134 mm height and whether they sit on the rack's units is not known.
gaps.wanted: the heights of the three bolt holes against the rack's first unit

gaps.note: three midspan brackets ship with the part and divide the interior space between the two channels (the brochure: 40-60, 50-50 or 60-40); the spine is drawn as a 60 mm plate zone and the brackets are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: the bracket (AR8682 is its 10 in spare) dimensioned

gaps.note: the doors have an oval opening near their top in the instruction sheet's figure; it is not drawn.
how far the manager stands from the upright when bolted on is not dimensioned; the part is drawn alone.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the manager fitted to an upright
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the colour, the plastic fingers, the hardware, the provided doors, installation guide and three midspan brackets, UL Listed and EU RoHS compliant are the data sheet and the instruction sheet.

capacity.note: datasheet - the AR8645 data sheet and the brochure state no cable capacity. None is estimated.

chassis.note: datasheet - 253 x 2134 x 660, doors fitted: "Width 10.0 in (253 mm)" (10 in is 254.0; drawn as printed), "Height 84.02 in (2134 mm)", "Depth 26.0 in (660 mm)".

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black"; every image APC publishes is a render, so it is drawn black.

depth.note: estimated - the 660 is the data sheet's, drawn as two wells of 300 and a 60 back plate zone between them (see ar8625).

front.note: estimated - the front face with its door fitted, placed as the AR8625's with the right finger column at 225. The `duct` guide is the 197 between the finger columns.

guides.note: estimated - each channel between the two finger columns of its face, run down the height (`run: y`); pitch the rack unit, 44.45, as the data sheet's "1U increments", gap the pitch less the 31 mm finger, 13.45.

left.note: estimated - the back plate between the two finger zones, as the AR8625's.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as the AR8625's are (see ar8625): the AR8645 data sheet, the instruction sheet 990-4576A-001 and the brochure. THE FIGURES THE DATA SHEET PRINTS ARE `datasheet`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE INSTRUCTION SHEET'S FIGURES IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it. No drawing or photograph is copied.

mount.note: datasheet - `rack-side`, as the AR8625 (see ar8625): "Mounting Mode: Not rack-mountable" on the data sheet, bolted to the side of the upright by the instruction sheet's three hex bolts. It occupies no rack unit. `ru: 44` is the rack height it runs beside, the fingers' 44 units: the height of the AR203A and one short of the AR201's 45, so one figure places it beside either (lint L154 judges a part by `ru`; the 2134 mm of the data sheet is the whole part). Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say.

rear.note: estimated - the rear face, the same parts placed the same way; `rear-duct` is the rear channel.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: estimated - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX (see ar8625): a sheet body whose solid is a well on each face with its 88 fingers and its door.

thickness.note: estimated - no APC document states a gauge; 1.5 is a sheet of this kind.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0, as the AR8625's at this width.

weight.note: datasheet - "Net Weight 75.0 lb(US) (34 kg)"; packed 43.1 kg.
